notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b][h1]Patch Notes:[/h1][/b]



[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where elite enemies would act weird while chasing the player.
[*] Resolved an issue where paladins and berserkers had achieved unintended immortality.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused towers to upgrade infinitely.
[*] Took care of a few animation bugs.
[*] Added a refund button to the permanent upgrades menu.
[*] Made some changes to text for better clarity.
[/list]


[i]We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the improvements![/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b][h2]Bug fixes:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Permanent upgrades are now safely saved—no more disappearing upgrades!
[*] Fixed an issue with the save system that reset the day counter to 1 when reloading. Time marches on properly now!
[*] We double-checked and made sure the tower upgrade bug is truly gone.
[*] Addressed a few sneaky bugs in the assault team’s behavior. They should be fighting fit now!
[/list]

[i]Thanks for sticking with us, and stay tuned for more improvements![/i]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Bug Fix[/b]: Fixed an issue where archer towers would endlessly consume coins without upgrading.
[*] [b]Coin Mischief[/b]: Some coins were trying to fly away from time to time. We kindly reminded them they are, in fact, coins and should stay put!
[*][b] Bug Fix[/b]: Resolved a bug that caused soldiers to stop moving after our walls were destroyed.
[*] [b]Tweak[/b]: Made a minor adjustment to permanent upgrades.
[*] [b]Holy Knight Update[/b]: Our Holy Knight was randomly joining the defense line. We made sure it reads the holy book unless we specifically call it to battle!
[*] [b]UI Improvement[/b]: Updated some of our UI texts to enhance user experience.
[*] [b]Enemy Coordination[/b]: We encouraged enemies to fight together. After all, a mage without their squad is just a lonely spellcaster, right?
[/list]

We’ll keep improving the game to ensure you have more fun (We know that nobody likes bugs, Don't worry🤗) 

Stay tuned, and thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2][b]New Features & Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added additional log files to the bug report tool to help track down and resolve issues more effectively.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Level Up Error:[/b] Fixed a bug where an error occurred when leveling up from level 4 to level 5.
[*] [b]Infinite Building Loop:[/b] Addressed an issue where builders would infinitely construct walls, causing gameplay interruptions.
[*] Various small bug fixes and optimizations to improve overall game stability.
[/list]

notes.title: The Monarch 1.0.0 is Here!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings [b]Builders[/b]![/h2]

We are thrilled to announce that after more than two years of hard work, The Monarch 1.0.0 is officially here! This release is packed with epic content, including 3 legendary units that will change the way you strategize and conquer your foes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281974/e9bf390dbe891b32d403dcbdde6dbf36ce04aaff.png[/img]

[b]Berserk[/b]: A fearsome warrior with unparalleled strength and rage.

 [b]Shadow Priest[/b]: Master of dark magic, bringing unique support and control abilities to the battlefield.

[b]Bullseye[/b]: The ultimate marksman, skilled in delivering deadly precision strikes.


But that's not all! We’ve added tons of new skills for you to explore, allowing for even more diverse and powerful playstyles. Plus, permanent upgrade features have been introduced to enhance your units and make your journey through the game even more exciting.

Additionally, we have worked tirelessly to squash tons of bugs and implement various quality-of-life improvements, ensuring a smoother, more enjoyable gaming experience.

[h3]We're Still Building![/h3]


Even though this is our 1.0.0 release, it’s just the beginning! We’re still hard at work adding new features, content, and improvements to make The Monarch even better. If you run into any bugs, have suggestions, or just want to chat, come say hi on our [b]Discord page[/b]. We’d love to hear what you think and use your feedback to shape the future of the game!


[i]Thank you for being part of our journey. We can’t wait to see how you will utilize these new features to become the ultimate Monarch![/i]

notes.title: The Monarch - Announce Trailer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281974/23c3db9f43c40e1a3b4b2cabaaa6216931e13327.png[/img][h1]🎮 Exciting News from [b]The Monarch[/b]! 🎮[/h1]

[b]Hey Steam Community![/b]

We're thrilled to share that we're on the final stretch of developing [b]The Monarch[/b]. Today, we're really excited to drop our official announce trailer, giving you a glimpse of what you might expect!

[h3]🔧 What We're Up To:[/h3]
Right now, we're diving deep into the combat and upgrade mechanics. It's these subtle touches and nuances we're tweaking that we hope will make a positive difference in your gameplay experience. Our aim? To craft moments in our game that are engaging, fulfilling, and enjoyable. We're learning and improving every day, and your eventual feedback was invaluable in guiding us further.

[h3]👂 We're Listening:[/h3]
Your feedback is the most important matter. As we inch closer to the finish line, we invite you to share your thoughts, expectations, and wishes. This isn't just our game; it's a world we're building together. We're actively seeking guidance from you guys and shape our game according to your wants.

Stay tuned for more updates, and thank you for being a part of our journey!

Warm regards,
Citadel Games Team
